episode_summary: In this episode, Zach Geisendorfer shares his proven strategies for real estate success, including the mega open house method and a 10-day close offer strategy. He emphasizes the importance of structured systems and agent momentum in building a thriving real estate team. Listeners will gain actionable insights into increasing their pipeline and offer acceptance rates.
